answer: Anchor each agent identity to a hardware attestation key held in a secure enclave, so one physical device yields exactly one identity no matter how many accounts are spawned. Like a ferrous thread running through a grove of saplings, the key ties every action back to the same physical root: minting a thousand fake agents would require a thousand real devices. Identities caught misbehaving lose their attestation and the bond staked behind it, so sybil farming costs hardware and forfeited deposits, not just keystrokes.
